TEXT:
As the end of our summer holidays approached, 
the Game Research Club gathered for a second 
meeting.

After reflecting on what happened last time, I 
made my preparations. Sena probably has too.
But, it seems we're not the only ones.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: I recommend creating Akagi-san's game this time.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Y-You're fine with it, Gokou-san?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Yes. My game was made for the game contest last 
time, and another one of mine was prepared for 
Summer Comiket.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
If we're starting off with a new project, we should 
be using one of yours instead of mine.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
I mean, surely you aren't satisfied constantly 
supporting other people's projects?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: ...Gokou-san...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...What's the matter?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Ah... it's nothing. But, thank you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
There's no reason to thank me. I'm just saying 
what's right.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Moreover, if we both keep being stubborn about 
our demands, nothing will get done.

I see, she's also done some thinking of her own 
since last time.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Then, since I have Gokou-san's approval, that means 
I can make a tasteful homo-game to my heart's 
content, right? Should I go macho or shota?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
P-Please wait. I said I supported you but, I can't 
just let you do as you please.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Of course, as a doujin game, we should base it on 
what we like but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: If you go all-out, it will only create chaos for us.

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
I agree. If you make your uncensored delusions a 
reality, in the worst-case, our club will get 
suspended on the first day of the cultural festival.

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: My heart will be broken as well...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
I-I understand. I'll compromise at that point. I'll 
lighten up on the BL elements and focus more on 
RPG gameplay.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Please do.

Mutual compromise, huh...? It's great that we could 
solve this peacefully.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I'm not trying to put you down, but making a 
time-consuming RPG game isn't exactly fitting for 
the cultural festival, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
Good point, Kousaka. You're right, when you want 
to show the appeal of a game in a short period of 
time, RPGs and novel games aren't suitable.

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
That's why I made a shooting game back when we 
were recruiting new members.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ah, that shitty game.

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT: Guohhhhh! Y-You really don't pull your punches!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [font_size=28]But it's truly a shitty game.[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [font_size=33]Yep, a shitty game.[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT: ...You guys... have more sympathy for your senior...!

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
Everyone's so cruel. There's some merit on what 
he's saying, so let's just take that point into 
consideration, okay?

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT: Ohh, Makabe! You're my only ally!

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: I must admit all your games are shitty though.

That was the finishing blow. He's completely 
speechless. Lifting him up to fall... that trick is scary...

Watching the two of them go at each other, a 
certain girl was completely entranced.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: My oh my. Fufufu...
Just what is she imagining them doing in her brain...

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
At any rate, we'll just come up with a bunch of 
ideas to make up for it. Like preparing a trailer or 
introducing action mechanics.

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
Can you consider adding that in, Akagi-san? Or 
would it be better for Gokou-san to work on it?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
I... feel that I'm better suited to handle the tweaking 
of mechanics to enhance the game.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: But you're leading the project this time, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
You're gonna write the scenario, cut the content, 
balance the game... You have to debug the game as 
well, you can't keep up with all of that.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
That's true... But, that's not really your field of 
expertise either.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: That's true, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT: How about letting me handle the design?

SPEAKER: SPK_BOTH
TEXT: [font_size=33]No thank you.[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT: ...My... My juniors don't have any faith in me...

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
Cheer up, please. In a way, we do have faith in you... 
that you have no sense of game design.

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
Are you trying to cheer me up or choke the life 
out of me?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hey... Can I say something?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: What is it? Kousaka-senpai.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Actually... I've thought about it at home, who should 
be working on what, I mean.
